Grants #e${30*#d}% increased damage and causes enemies to explode on death, dealing 162.5 damage in a ? meter radius.

Explosions inherit the weapon's element and <link Combatant Damage Scaling [#CombatantScaling] />. Explosions triggered with Linear Fusion Rifle kills deal an additional 30% increased damage.
